name: choir-assistant
description: Turn a PDF choral score into an evidence-reviewed, synchronized rehearsal workbench.

interface.shortDescription: PDF scores to interactive choir rehearsal
interface.longDescription: Import a PDF score, inspect its musical structure, review source-bound corrections, and open a synchronized score and audio workbench with a metronome and experimental pitch practice.
defaultPrompt: Use $choir-workbench to import this PDF score and generate a reviewed rehearsal workbench.
用 $choir-workbench 导入这份 PDF 曲谱，完成全谱校准并打开排练工作台。
